name: JobTread
description:
Connect Claude directly to your JobTread account to manage your construction business through natural conversation. This server gives Claude secure access to your JobTread data, so you can get answers, make updates, and stay on top of your projects without switching between tools.

With the JobTread MCP server, you can:

- Jobs & projects — Look up job details, check statuses, create new jobs, and update project information.
- Estimates & budgets — Review estimates, pull line-item details, and track budget vs. actual costs.
- Schedules — View upcoming tasks and milestones, check timelines, and keep projects on track.
- Customers & contacts — Search customer records, review history, and manage contact information.
- Vendors & subcontractors — Access vendor details and manage your trade partner relationships.
- Documents & daily logs — Reference job-related records to keep everyone aligned.

Whether you're a builder, remodeler, or specialty contractor, the JobTread MCP server turns Claude into a hands-on assistant for your day-to-day operations — answering questions like "What's the status of the Henderson kitchen remodel?" or "Pull up this month's open estimates" in seconds.

Your data stays secure through JobTread's authenticated API, and Claude only accesses what you authorize.

_published_faq.name: How do I add JobTread to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add JobTread to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.jobtread.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the JobTread MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: JobTread provides these MCP tools: query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to JobTread?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to JobTread in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
JobTread requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
JobTread is developed by JobTread. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
